notes: cover_title_match: cover lines 凌晨上山拍云海 / 雾散以后，山谷里 / 多出一整片人家 promise the same core as the actual title 我们等了一场同样的雨，雾散以后，山谷里多出了一整片人家 - the same waiting-through-rain, fog-clearing, whole-settlement-appears promise.

cover_frame01_handoff: cover and body01 are the same dawn overlook composition (P01/P02 selfie, rain-spotted SUV, wet asphalt, cloud-filled valley), so body01 continues the cover promise with no bait-and-switch.
first3_coherence: 01 dawn selfie -> 02 drone lifted just to film the scenery -> 03 first wet roof after passing through cloud reads as one continuous entry path, not three unrelated hooks.

climax_upgrade: climax frame 19 (controller in the crossed-out disconnect state plus her first blocking objection 别去了) is irreversible in a way the opening selfie is not; payoff 20 then shows the ordinary sunrise and cloud sea with an absent drone.

payoff_honesty: the payoff adds no new mechanism - the loss is set up by 17 (stutter and dropping altitude), 18 (frozen last cache with the small foreign bright patch) and 19 (lost link), and 20 only pays off the missing drone.

description_consistency: description is first-person fictional narration that mirrors the final captions frame by frame; topics stay generic genre tags (#AI故事 #彼此的天空 #第一人称悬疑 #川西自驾 #云海 #抖音图文); no official fact, real case, third-party metric or verification claim is made, and the closing line 人物、地点、情节均为虚构，画面由AI生成。 scopes the fiction for the reader.

no_caption_invented_core_evidence: captions add first-person context only; the contested ones stay inside frame-contract required_visual_cues - frame 12 大人顺视线抬头并把孩子拉到身后, frame 13 摆出的东西往回收而有人仍未察觉, frame 18 缓存屏幕内一小块异质亮区, frame 19 失联提示与她的手拦动作, frame 20 日出云海里缺席的无人机.

subtitle_left_middle_and_unobstructed: meta/subtitle-layout-audit.json is the canonical render of the rewritten captions with layout_current true and per-frame base/output SHA; meta/caption-image-audit.json is PASS for all 20 final publish frames (supported true, subtitle_unobstructed true), with 13 frames re-reviewed for the new caption text and 7 reused by unchanged caption/pixel SHA.

caption_conversational_hook_quality: the 20 captions were rewritten onto the EP001/EP002 register - short spoken first-person lines, single-sentence beats where the beat is the strongest, no 我发现/我看到 narration prefixes, no three-beat parallel listing, no restating native on-screen text (frame 19 now carries her objection instead of the controller glyphs), and each frame renders as one line at 42px in the layout audit; no forbidden technical vocabulary from the voice card appears.

description close: the description ends on a restrained line with a trailing ellipsis (只是那架本来应该飞在画面里的无人机，一直没有回来……) matching the series ending habit, and the pinned comment still points at frame 02, frame 18 and frame 20, all of which keep the same cues.
cover face check: YuNet faces on cover.png end at y=859 while the cover text bands start at y=972, so the cover copy does not cover either face.
